title: Deepen the top architecture candidates measured by depth.ts
body: Follow-up of t-87ks15p: deepen the ranked candidates in .krn/runs/lead/architecture-candidates.md (scripts/architecture/depth.ts measures before/after): split the trace/index.ts hub (1457 lines), narrow verdict/sandbox.ts to execute, split hosts/codex.ts isolation modes into two adapters, split flow/types.ts by owner; extend depth.ts with unimported-export report and .mjs scan; enforce KRN-05 in Lint (dependency-cruiser, from t-phsq5re).
